analysis: focal shunting perturbation of exact credit on real MICrONS morphologies
interpretation_level: mechanistic passive-network test on measured anatomy
primary_contrast_scope: The legacy primary_contrast object below is restricted to the 40-cell, 230-site subset eligible for the within-cell depth-shuffled relation control. The publication-facing all-eligible 45-cell, 235-site primary estimate is in ../replication_summary.json.

depth_shuffled_relation_control.procedure: 200 relation templates sampled from other focal sites, stratified by focal-site topological-depth quartile when another site was available; otherwise sampled from another site in the same cell
